The implementation therefore changes the supervision paths despite claiming to preserve the copied disparity-head math. A focused check with a zero update head confirmed nonzero gradients through the base proposal.

stale_rows.actual: The coarse regression omits the original proposal detach. This is the same finding reported above, not an additional semantic gap.
